purpose: Register a validation-only paired screen for a low-rank, window-conditioned channel-state mixer that is shared by the MambaACF forecast and AutoCon representation paths.
research_question: Can the efficient shared-hidden-summary, window-conditioned global data-dependent channel-state mixer preserve or improve H96 forecasting relative to the same train-only ACF MambaACF reference, while keeping measured compute and memory within a predeclared budget and retaining an explicit AutoCon relation-loss contrast?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory screen on two existing CSV datasets, one horizon, and three seeds per arm. It registers no completed metric and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, contrastive-learning, accuracy, efficiency, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: The candidate is a CMamba-inspired low-rank state adapter, not an exact reproduction of any external architecture. Its state is conditioned on the observed normalized window, so strict representation-causality claims are disabled and must not be inferred from a favorable forecast result.

required_before_launch: human review of the candidate's observed-window conditioning and non-strict representation-causality boundary
verify the current source snapshot, environment record, and both dataset SHA256 fingerprints
run a parameter and device-resident resource smoke for every architecture arm under one fixed hardware protocol
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root
confirm that validation metrics, never test metrics, select or stop an arm

prelaunch_gates: human review of the candidate's observed-window conditioning and non-strict representation-causality boundary

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh exploratory output root. Retain the runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, train-only ACF prior, checkpoint, validation trajectory, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: plain_baselines_h96
phases.purpose: Fixed-budget accuracy references; these rows are descriptive and do not receive the candidate's ACF or AutoCon options.

phases.name: mamba_acf_reference_h96
phases.purpose: Paired MambaACF reference with static train-only raw ACF forecast memory and the candidate mixer disabled.

phases.name: mamba_acf_channel_state_h96
phases.purpose: The same MambaACF forecast path as the reference plus the fixed rank-4 low-rank, observed-window-conditioned global channel-state mixer that reuses the existing shared hidden summary.

phases.name: mamba_acf_channel_state_relation_null_h96
phases.purpose: AutoCon representation arm with the same channel-state mixer and a registered lambda=0 relation null; it isolates the incremental relation objective.

phases.name: mamba_acf_channel_state_relation_h96
phases.purpose: AutoCon relation arm with the same channel-state mixer, sidecar, sampler, and budget as the null, using the fixed exploratory lambda=0.03.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The reference-to-candidate contrast estimates the incremental forecast-path effect of the mixer. The relation-null-to-relation contrast estimates the incremental signed AutoCon objective under the same mixer. Neither contrast identifies an external architecture's effect.

accuracy_gate.candidate_vs_mamba_acf_reference: In each dataset, mean validation scaled-MSE ratio candidate/reference <= 1.000, at least 2 of 3 paired seed wins, and no seed-level ratio above 1.05.
accuracy_gate.candidate_vs_plain_baselines: For each dataset, compare against the lowest mean validation scaled MSE among DLinear, NLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, Mamba1, and Mamba2. A candidate ratio <= 1.010 is a screening pass; this is a validation-only descriptive gate, not non-inferiority evidence.
accuracy_gate.relation_vs_null: In each dataset, mean validation scaled-MSE ratio relation/null <= 1.000 and at least 2 of 3 paired seed wins. A null result is retained as evidence against promoting the relation objective.
accuracy_gate.uncertainty: Report every seed, paired delta, mean/median ratio, and a paired confidence interval; do not pool datasets as independent replicates or use a test metric for selection.

resource_gate.protocol: Run scripts/benchmark_model_resources.py on the same source snapshot with device-resident synthetic inputs, fixed batch=8, warmup=25, timed=100, input seed=2718, and the same device. Separately summarize successful manifest elapsed_sec for end-to-end training jobs.
resource_gate.candidate_vs_mamba_acf_reference: Median forward latency, p95 latency, steady-state peak allocated memory, and active trainable parameters must each be <= 1.10x the paired MambaACF reference on both ETTh1/C=7 and Traffic/C=862. A speed claim requires a measured latency or end-to-end elapsed improvement, not merely parameter counts.
resource_gate.candidate_vs_mamba2: Report the same metrics against Mamba2 as an external baseline reference. Do not claim faster-than-Mamba2 unless the complete matched measurement passes and confidence intervals/replicate dispersion are reported.
resource_gate.missing_measurement: Any missing, mixed-device, source-mismatched, or synthetic-only row invalidates the efficiency gate; do not impute or copy historical resource values.

comparison_contract.promotion_rule: Promote only after all accuracy and resource gates pass in both datasets, all 60 jobs have complete paired artifacts, source/data/config hashes match, and a new human-reviewed confirmation plan is frozen. This draft itself cannot establish a paper result.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation and dry-run expansion are the only permitted actions for this draft.
Do not use test metrics, historical artifacts, or a later resource run to alter the registered arm set, seed set, horizon, lambda, or rank after observing validation results.
If the candidate fails the MambaACF reference gate or adds measured cost without an accuracy benefit, retain the reference as the simpler result and stop candidate expansion.
If the relation arm fails its null contrast, report the relation objective as exploratory and do not tune lambda or sampler on these same seeds.
Do not promote to longer horizons, additional datasets, strict representation-causality claims, or publication claims from this screen alone.
